---
title: "مدحِ حیدرؑ کرتے ہیں اہلِ جفا کے سامنے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Madh e Haider kartay hain ahle e jafa ke samnay
Ham charagh apnay jalatay hain hawa ke samnay

1
Ya Ali ham ne kaha aur mushkilain sab tal gayeen
Mushkilain thairain gi kiay mushkil kusha ke samnay

2
Koi dunya may nahi hay misl e Shah e La fata
Aazmana hay to dekhay koi aa ke samnay

3
Chorr kar nafs e Khuda ko hain talabgar e riza
Janay ke kis munh se aatay hain Khuda ke samnay

4
Sab ilaj de jism hay aur ye dawa e rooh hay
Sab dawain gard hain khak e shifa ke samnay

5
Wo hay sajdon ki jaghay aur ye hay sajdon ki ameen
Kaabay ko ham kaise layain Karbala ke samnay

6
Khoon e Asghar mal ke chahray par huay jaise Hussain
Surkharoo kia ho ga koyi yun Khuda ke samnay

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/mdh-haidar-krte-hain-ahl-jfa-ke-samne.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
assert all(not line or line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines())
for edition, digits in [(roman, '123456'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵۶')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2] + [3] * 6
    assert ''.join(block[0].strip() for block in blocks[1:]) == digits
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Both editions have a two-verse opening and six matching numbered couplets.')
PY"
